# Public external dataset

- **Dataset:** [GSE66890](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE66890)
- **Platform:** [GPL6244](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GPL6244)

Download the following files from GEO and place them in this directory:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| GSE66890_series_matrix.txt.gz | Gene-expression matrix and sample information |
| GPL6244.annot.gz | Probe-to-gene annotation |

These are two files for one external cohort. Alternative paths can be set with CF_GEO_MATRIX and CF_GEO_PLATFORM in scripts/config.R.
